title: Linear Functions: Slope, Forms of a Line and Scatter Plots | Algebra I, Unit 5
description:
Find slope from a graph and from two points, write and graph lines in slope-intercept, point-slope and standard form, compare parallel and perpendicular lines, transform linear graphs, and fit a line to a scatter plot. Each section ends with a practice problem.
